result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d make it impossible for anyone to remain indifferent to the suffering of others.

Not by force, not by law—but by giving every person an unmistakable, visceral sense of what someone else is feeling. The way we flinch when we see a stranger hurt, or the way a cry cuts through noise. If that signal were always on, if empathy couldn’t be muted by distance, ideology, or exhaustion, then cruelty would become unbearable to the one committing it. Wars would be harder to start. Greed would lose its grip. Injustice would be impossible to ignore.

Everything else—poverty, violence, exploitation—would still take work to fix. But at least we’d all finally *want* to fix it.
